name: thoth
description: THOTH — open source pentest reporting platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w @thoth/shared && npm run build -w @thoth/api && npm run build -w @thoth/worker && npm run build -w @thoth/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -ws --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test -w @thoth/shared && npm run test -w @thoth/api && npm run test -w @thoth/web
